m1's docket item 3: proposal B is the d_sem/d_sens missingTerms question under another name, and proposal C -- the cell-trace function -- DEPENDS on B, so C needs no separate ruling until B lands. NO ACTION REQUIRED from the chief beyond the item 1 ruling.
